title: klad: give your coding agent real brushes
author: QuantumWhisker
selftext:
I've been developing applications for a long time and have turned to game development as well lately. One of the things that frustrated me the most was that using AI agents for game development is very annoying in the art department.

Your only options right now are to either use an image genAI model and roll the dice every time you want to make an edit, or have your agent draw with something like vectors.

I was looking for an application that would allow me to ask an agent to make a first draft of whatever art I needed with actual brushes, and then be able to go in myself and edit every last stroke or layer that it created.

Klad is that application. Written in Rust, it can be fully controlled by an agent through the CLI, and every function is available in a nice UI as well: a brush engine, frame-by-frame animation (and bones/IK), vectors, text layers, colours, layer effects,…

I use it every day on Mac, so that definitely works well. It builds on Linux too (tablet pen pressure still needs some work there). Windows should work, although this has not been tested yet.

Clone the repo to try it out: [https://github.com/klad-app/klad](https://github.com/klad-app/klad)

The quality of the drawings really depends on the agent you use. I have tried it since the release of Fable 5.2 this morning, and the drawings are already quite impressive. I'm confident that this will only improve.

It's source available: free for personal use and for companies under 500k a year, and what you draw is yours to use in your games.

There are no signed builds yet, these are in the pipeline. You can leave your email at [https://klad.studio](https://klad.studio) to get a notification when one is out. I'll be selling these for $15 to people on the list, to further support Klad's development.

What do I want to hear from people who try it: does it build, and if not, which OS and what error? Can your agent handle it? Can you use the UI yourself? Can you edit something easily? Where are you getting stuck?

thanks for reading!
